hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Collects a 1.7% fee on buys (ETH) and sells (token), routing buy fees to a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn operations. Every 20 swaps with a non-empty burn pot, a buyback is flagged; sells in the same block as a buyback are blocked. Liquidity addition is permanently gated to a single provider, and sell access can be restricted to an admin-controlled allowlist via a publicly-triggerable `timeBased` flag.
